widgets_values:
# Herrgotts H3 Infinite v1.3 — Stitch Saved Chain

Use this workflow after generating clips separately with the **v1.3 Start** and **v1.3 Continue** workflows. It reads the manually numbered **full AV latents** (`clip_00001.safetensors`, `clip_00002.safetensors`, ...), reconstructs the freeze-safe boundaries and writes one final MP4.

### Normal use
1. Load the same **Video VAE** and **Audio VAE** used for generation.
2. Keep `latent_prefix = h3_continuous/clip` if you used the example Save nodes.
3. `first_clip = 1`. Leave `last_clip = 0` to stitch through the highest numbered saved clip, or set an explicit final clip.
4. Recommended seam defaults remain unchanged: **Safe Tail Bridge max 2 frames**, **4 video crossfade frames**, **15 ms audio crossfade**, **luminance match OFF**.
5. Queue this workflow. No H3 diffusion model or text encoder is needed.

v1.3 deliberately keeps the proven **manual Save / Load clip indexing** used by earlier releases. First/Last keyframe flexibility and Qwen References affect conditioning during generation; the stable stitching format remains unchanged.

nodes.title: INFO — Why this scales to long chains
widgets_values:
### Memory behavior
The stitcher does **not** decode every clip into one giant ComfyUI IMAGE batch. It processes one saved AV latent at a time, writes finished frames/audio directly into the output MP4, keeps only a tiny boundary buffer, then releases the decoded clip.

Safe Tail Bridge needs at most **2 extra rendered frames** by default, plus the short video/audio crossfade buffers. Peak RAM/VRAM therefore stays roughly tied to **one decoded H3 clip + the two VAEs**, rather than growing with 10, 20 or 50 clips. Disk usage still grows with saved latents and the final video.

nodes.title: INFO — Saved metadata / manual indexing
widgets_values:
### Self-describing saved clips
Saved clips store each clip's **actual reused head-context length** together with its full AV latent and Auto Handover metadata. This lets the stitcher reconstruct the correct boundaries without the original generation graph.

Generation Save / Load indices remain intentionally **manual** in v1.3: keep a predictable sequence such as `clip_00001`, `clip_00002`, ... and choose the exact index when continuing or overwriting a branch.

Older saved clips can often still work because the stitcher can recover the next head length from the previous clip's phase-aligned handover metadata. If required information is missing, it stops instead of guessing.

For best results, use the same resolution + Video/Audio VAEs throughout the chain.

### Safe Tail Bridge
When H3's phase-aligned latent cutoff falls 1–3 frames before the detector's already-safe ideal end, those rendered pixels are still usable even though they cannot be passed as latent anchors.

With `max_safe_tail_bridge_frames = 2`, the stitcher keeps up to two of those exact frames from the previous clip and skips the same number of early **video** frames in the next clip. It never crosses the detector's safety boundary and never changes total duration.

After that, a short **4-frame context-aligned video blend** smooths the pixel decode seam. Audio keeps the separately tested **15 ms de-click crossfade** and is not shifted by Safe Tail Bridge.

`luminance_match` is kept only as an experimental fallback and is **off by default**.
